title: RIAD/RIDD protein-scaffold PSCI-PairRank: code and minimal reproducibility data
description:
Frozen code and compact data for reproducing PSCI assembly from deposited descriptor inputs, the literature architecture prior, Internal16 M0-M3 whole-system evaluation, reported metrics, and computational check figures.

Project-authored derived data are released under CC BY 4.0; literature-derived metadata retain source-specific licensing terms described in DATA_LICENSE.md.
